headline: Daiichi Sankyo Q2 FY2026 Earnings Slide on Oncology Surge
summary: Daiichi Sankyo reported its Q2 FY2026 financial results, highlighting a strong surge in oncology that drove record growth.
why: Pharmaceutical companies rely on successful oncology pipelines to drive revenue expansion and offset patent expirations on legacy drugs.

impacts.name: Daiichi Sankyo
impacts.why: Record growth driven by an oncology surge positively impacts the company's financial profile.
